molecules.name: Insulin
molecules.role: Master storage hormone — drives GLUT4 translocation, suppresses HSL, activates SREBP-1c; chronic elevation = insulin resistance core

molecules.name: Testosterone (T)
molecules.label_th: เทสโทสเตอโรน
molecules.role: Primary male androgen (also in women at 1/10 level); produced in Leydig cells; converted to DHT (5α-reductase) and estradiol (aromatase)

molecules.name: Dihydrotestosterone (DHT)
molecules.role: Most potent androgen (~3-5× T at AR); responsible for hair loss, prostate growth, male-pattern secondary sex traits

molecules.name: Estradiol (E2)
molecules.label_th: เอสตราไดออล
molecules.role: Dominant estrogen in reproductive-age women; also present in men (from aromatase); regulates bone, cardiovascular, brain health

molecules.name: Estrone (E1)
molecules.role: Dominant estrogen after menopause; produced mostly in adipose tissue via aromatase — more fat = more E1

molecules.name: Progesterone
molecules.label_th: โปรเจสเตอโรน
molecules.role: Luteal-phase hormone; calming effect via allopregnanolone/GABA-A; first hormone to fall in perimenopause

molecules.name: Cortisol
molecules.role: Main stress hormone; diurnal rhythm (AM peak); raises glucose, suppresses immune, chronic excess → visceral fat + hippocampal atrophy

molecules.name: ACTH (adrenocorticotropic hormone)
molecules.role: Stimulates adrenal cortex to produce cortisol; released in response to CRH + circadian pacemaker

molecules.name: CRH (corticotropin-releasing hormone)
molecules.role: Initiates HPA axis → ACTH → cortisol; also directly stimulates sympathetic arousal

molecules.name: TSH (thyroid-stimulating hormone)
molecules.role: Stimulates thyroid to produce T4 > T3; reference range 0.4-4.0 mIU/L; inversely correlated with thyroid hormone

molecules.name: Thyroxine (T4)
molecules.label_th: T4 / ไทรอกซิน
molecules.role: Main thyroid output (90%); prohormone — peripheral deiodinase (D1/D2) converts to active T3

molecules.name: Triiodothyronine (T3)
molecules.role: Active thyroid hormone; binds nuclear TR receptor; regulates BMR, thermogenesis, heart rate

molecules.name: Reverse T3 (rT3)
molecules.role: Inactive T4 metabolite; rises in chronic illness/fasting — thyroid's 'brake pedal'

molecules.name: Growth Hormone (GH / somatotropin)
molecules.label_th: โกรทฮอร์โมน
molecules.role: Pulsatile; amplified by fasting + deep sleep; drives lipolysis + IGF-1; declines ~14%/decade (somatopause)

molecules.name: IGF-1 (insulin-like growth factor 1)
molecules.role: Mediates most anabolic effects of GH; marker of integrated GH status (vs pulsatile GH)

molecules.name: GHRH
molecules.role: Stimulates anterior pituitary to release GH

molecules.name: Somatostatin (GHIH)
molecules.label_th: โซมาโทสแตติน
molecules.role: Inhibits GH + insulin + glucagon; rises postprandially; falls during fasting → disinhibits GH pulse

molecules.name: Leptin
molecules.role: Satiety signal from adipocytes to hypothalamic POMC; proportional to fat mass; resistance → obesity

molecules.name: Ghrelin
molecules.role: Pre-meal hunger signal; rises with sleep deprivation; stimulates GH secretion

molecules.name: Melatonin
molecules.role: Circadian dark signal; peak 02:00-04:00; suppressed by blue light; gates downstream hormone rhythms

molecules.name: DHEA / DHEAS
molecules.role: Precursor to T and E2; peaks age ~25, declines ~80% by 70 ('adrenopause'); most abundant circulating steroid

molecules.name: Aromatase (CYP19A1)
molecules.role: Converts testosterone → estradiol; highly expressed in adipose tissue → more fat = more aromatization

molecules.name: 5α-Reductase
molecules.label_th: 5-อัลฟารีดักเตส
molecules.role: Converts testosterone → DHT; inhibited by finasteride/dutasteride (BPH, hair loss drugs)

molecules.name: SHBG (sex hormone-binding globulin)
molecules.role: Binds T + E2 → reduces bioavailable fraction; low SHBG = marker of insulin resistance

molecules.name: LH (luteinizing hormone)
molecules.role: Stimulates Leydig cells (T) + triggers ovulation; pulse pattern maturation key to puberty + fertility

molecules.name: FSH (follicle-stimulating hormone)
molecules.role: Stimulates follicle maturation + Sertoli cells; rises sharply in menopause (>30 IU/L marker)

molecules.name: Prolactin
molecules.role: Lactation driver; high levels in men suppress T and libido (prolactinoma red flag)

molecules.name: Oxytocin
molecules.label_th: อ็อกซิโทซิน
molecules.role: Pair-bonding, uterine contraction, milk ejection; modulates social behavior and stress recovery

organizations.name: North American Menopause Society (now 'The Menopause Society')

case_studies.name: Ho 1988 GH-Fasting Study
case_studies.claim_to_fame: 6 healthy men, 5-day water fast — GH pulse frequency rose from 5.8 → 9.9 /24h; amplitude also increased
case_studies.source: Ho KY et al., J Clin Invest 1988 (PMC329619)

case_studies.name: Travison Secular T-Decline Study
case_studies.claim_to_fame: Massachusetts Male Aging Study: men aged 65-69 had ~17% lower total T in 2004 than age-matched men in 1987 — a population-wide secular decline independent of individual aging
case_studies.source: Travison TG et al., JAMA 2007; PMID 17264187

case_studies.name: The T Trials (Snyder et al. 2016)
case_studies.claim_to_fame: 790 men aged ≥65 with low T + symptoms — TRT improved sexual function modestly but had modest/no improvement in vitality and cognition; raised non-fatal coronary plaque
case_studies.source: Snyder PJ et al., NEJM 2016; PMID 26857598

case_studies.name: Women's Health Initiative (2002)
case_studies.claim_to_fame: Halted early: combined CEE+MPA in 16k women — increased breast cancer + CHD risk; later re-analyses show risk depends on timing (<60y) and hormone type
case_studies.source: Writing Group for WHI Investigators, JAMA 2002; JAMA 2017 follow-up

case_studies.name: Spiegel Sleep-Restriction Study
case_studies.claim_to_fame: Healthy men 4h sleep × 2 nights → leptin -18%, ghrelin +28%, hunger +24%, appetite for high-carb foods +33%
case_studies.source: Spiegel K et al., Ann Intern Med 2004; PMID 15583226

case_studies.name: Van Cauter 1999 Sleep Debt Study
case_studies.claim_to_fame: 11 young men, sleep 4h × 6 nights → glucose clearance slowed 40%, cortisol evening elevated 45%, insulin sensitivity dropped ~30% — prediabetic state from sleep loss alone
case_studies.source: Spiegel, Leproult, Van Cauter, Lancet 1999; PMID 10543671

case_studies.name: Rotterdam PCOS Consensus
case_studies.claim_to_fame: Established 2-of-3 criteria (hyperandrogenism, oligo/anovulation, polycystic morphology) — still dominant diagnostic framework 2 decades later
case_studies.source: Rotterdam ESHRE/ASRM-Sponsored PCOS Consensus Workshop Group, Fertil Steril 2004

case_studies.name: Czeisler Blue Light Study
case_studies.claim_to_fame: 4h of eReader vs book at night → melatonin onset delayed 1.5h; next-morning alertness decreased; next-day sleep pressure increased
case_studies.source: Chang A-M, Aeschbach D, Duffy JF, Czeisler CA, PNAS 2015; PMID 25535358

case_studies.name: DiRECT Trial (metabolic remission)
case_studies.claim_to_fame: 46% T2D remission at 12 months with ≥10 kg weight loss — insulin/C-peptide normalized; ectopic pancreatic fat decreased

case_studies.name: Corona DHEA meta-analysis
case_studies.claim_to_fame: 25 RCTs, 1353 subjects — DHEA supplementation in aging adults: no significant effect on sexual function, cognition, or body composition in men; modest improvement in female libido
case_studies.source: Corona G et al., J Sex Med 2013; PMID 23621575
